b:
Held in a sweet prison
in the mine of the heart,
he stays in memory,
a scripture of four letters

When a flood of feeling
pours out
from the store of your heart,
he puts up a speed bump;
and at your pain
he rises in fury

Like a tree
that grows the more you cut it,
in pointless quarrels he only
puts down deeper roots and stays

Even a mother's love,
which laid you in the cradle,
comes only as far as touch can reach;
but he
will take you
to the horizon

Pointing out your mistakes,
changing your track,
he is
another
father

With him
even rivalry turns into make-believe,
words take on new colours,
even silences give meaning

He leads you
to a world of wisdom
free from the folly
called difference;
there even money
is worthless coin,
and affection alone
is the barter

He is the one
who hides the spare key
to the secret box
you hid in your heart,
and the one who forgets it

Isn't he the very college
that taught you
love
and desire?

Not related
by blood,
he becomes your sibling
by feeling

He is no mushroom that sprang up in the rain
to be conquered by death;
he is the pollen of a flower
that bloomed,
ripened,
became a seed and sprouted
into a lasting tree

That sculptor
who keeps shaping you,
never undone
by time:
"friend"
note: "A scripture of four letters": the Tamil word for friend, நண்பன் (nanban), is written with four letters.
